_comment: Every test name here MUST run and report 'ok' in acceptance/acceptance.test.ts's TAP output for the acceptance-suite CI step to pass. This file is CODEOWNERS-protected alongside acceptance/ itself - adding, renaming, or removing a required case needs the owner's approval, same as the tests it lists.
required_test_names: acceptance: average of a single value is itself
acceptance: average of several values is the arithmetic mean
acceptance: average rejects an empty array
acceptance: percentOf computes a correct percentage
acceptance: percentOf rejects a zero whole
acceptance: ratioOf computes a correct ratio
acceptance: divide computes a real quotient
acceptance: divide rejects division by zero
